seo.title: Split PDF – Extract Pages or Ranges Free, No Upload
seo.desc: Split a PDF into single pages, page ranges, every X pages or even/odd pages – or click to cut. Free, private, in your browser. No upload, no sign-up.
sections: Every way to split a PDF, in one place

Splitting sounds simple, but people mean very different things by it: pulling out one chapter, separating a scanned stack into individual invoices, sending only the signed page, or breaking a huge file into e-mail-sized parts. {brand} covers all of these, and does it in your browser so the document is never uploaded.
**Every page** – one PDF per page, delivered as a ZIP.
**Where I click the scissors** – look at page thumbnails and click between pages to cut the document exactly where you want.
**Select page ranges** – type ranges such as 1-3, 7, 10-12 to extract just those pages (one file per range or merged into one).
**Every X pages** – split a 100-page scan into 2-page or 5-page documents in one step.
**Even / odd pages** – separate front and back sides of a duplex scan.
**By file size** – use [Split PDF by size](/split-pdf-by-size/) to get parts under an e-mail limit such as 10 MB.
**By bookmarks or chapters** – [Split PDF by bookmarks](/split-pdf-by-bookmarks/) creates one file per chapter automatically.
**By text** – [Split PDF by text](/split-pdf-by-text/) starts a new file whenever a word like 'Invoice' appears.
**Pages in half** – [Split pages in half](/split-pdf-pages-in-half/) cuts two-up scanned book spreads into single pages.

sections: Lossless and private

Splitting copies the original page objects into new PDFs – nothing is re-rendered or re-compressed, so text stays selectable, vector graphics stay sharp and images keep their quality. Links, form fields and fonts on the copied pages are kept.

Because the work happens locally, there is no waiting for an upload of a 200 MB scan, no hourly task limit like Sejda's 3 tasks per hour, and no copy of your bank statement or medical record on somebody else's server.
Tips
Page numbers in ranges refer to the physical page position (1 = first page), not to numbers printed on the page.
Want to remove pages instead of extracting them? Use [Delete PDF pages](/delete-pdf-pages/). To reorder, use [Organize PDF](/organize-pdf/).
Got the pieces and need some of them together again? [Merge PDF](/merge-pdf/) joins them in any order.
Password-protected file? Unlock it first with [Unlock PDF](/unlock-pdf/) if you know the password.
Common uses
Sending only the relevant pages of a contract or report.
Separating a scanned batch of invoices into one file per invoice.
Extracting a single chapter of an e-book or textbook for study.
Breaking a large portfolio into smaller parts that upload portals accept.
Sharing just the signature page for countersigning.

faq.q: How do I extract just a few pages from a PDF?
faq.a: Choose 'Select page ranges', type the pages such as 2-4, 9 and click Split. You can get each range as its own file or all together.
No. Pages are copied as they are, without re-compressing, so text and images look identical to the original.
No. The split runs in your browser and the file never leaves your device.

faq.q: Can I split a PDF into equal parts?
faq.a: Yes. Use 'Every X pages' and enter how many pages each part should have.

faq.q: How do I split a PDF to fit an e-mail size limit?
faq.a: Use Split PDF by size and set a maximum such as 10 MB; each part will stay under it.
Yes. Split PDF by bookmarks creates one file per bookmark (chapter) automatically.

faq.q: Is there a page or file limit?
faq.a: No. There are no hourly limits; very large files only depend on your device's memory.

faq.q: Will links and form fields still work?
faq.a: Yes, links and form fields on the copied pages are kept.

faq.q: Can I split a password-protected PDF?
faq.a: If you know the password, unlock it with Unlock PDF first, then split.

faqKw.q: How do I split a PDF into multiple files?
faqKw.a: Drop the PDF and choose how to split: every page as its own file, custom ranges such as 1-3,4-9, every X pages, or odd/even pages. You can also click between thumbnails to cut. The parts download as a ZIP.

faqKw.q: Can I split a PDF in half?
faqKw.a: Yes. Use a range such as 1-10,11-20 for a 20-page file, or ‘every X pages’ with half the page count. To cut each physical page down the middle (two scanned pages per sheet), use the Split PDF pages in half tool instead.
